question:
**Complete the following collocation.**

It is easier to make a promise than to _______ a promise.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Keep.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The collocation **"keep a promise"** is a commonly used phrase that means to fulfill or honor a promise. In the given sentence, the word "keep" is the appropriate choice to complete the collocation.
